ios.desc:
Made by parents and baby tested!

For best experience, use with Guided Access (in your apple settings).

20 unique interactive designs with familiar shapes, textures and bright colors to expand your child's visual vocabulary. 

Responds to touch to allow interaction and plays classical music!

Every scene is different with a * SURPRISE * at the end.

Ages 0-99! older kids and parents enjoy it too!

---
